g.text: READ-ONLY AVAILABILITY, NOT NEW MODEL RESULTS

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 24.48px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #172e47

g.text: Longer windows sharply reduce the normal evidence.

text.style: font-size: 17.28px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #506478

g.text: These upper-bound counts precede the final joint-profile and phase-reliability gates.

text.style: font-size: 13.68px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #172e47

g.text: A longer cycle estimate can reduce generalizability through selective exclusion.

text.style: font-size: 10.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #506478

g.text: Gait prediction | Proposed second iteration | November 2026
